mainText: Hello, Verona! At 1 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we have overcast skies at Verona City Hall with a temperature of 47 degrees. Tonight, the moon is in a Waning Gibbous phase. If you look up at 5:51 PM, you can catch the International Space Station appearing in the northwest over Middleton by the high school and tracking across the sky toward the southeast near Festival Foods for 4 minutes.

City Hall reminds residents that 2027 spring election candidate packets are available for the four Aldermanic districts. You must submit your Declaration of Candidacy and other required paperwork to the City Clerk at 111 Lincoln Street by 5:00 PM on January 5, 2027.

We have a busy couple of days ahead. Today, enjoy live music at Bailey Run Vineyard or the 50th-anniversary craft brewing event at Wisconsin Brewing Company. Tomorrow, you can catch more live music at Lake Lou-ee and Paddy Mac's, or check out The Crafty Fair at ART House 360 starting at 10 AM.

In our weekly look at department calls, on November 2, officers were called to the 100 block of West End Circle regarding a domestic disturbance, which resulted in a 48-year-old man being arrested for battery and disorderly conduct.
It is a delicious day to visit Culver's as they are serving the Snickers Swirl flavor of the day. They are open until 10:30 PM tonight, so there is still plenty of time to stop by for a treat.
